_about: Two worked examples of the project workbook. All numbers are made up for teaching.

setup.title: EXAMPLE: Could a celecoxib analogue be a better COX-2 inhibitor?
setup.question: Could a chlorinated analogue of celecoxib bind COX-2 as well as celecoxib and still look like an oral medicine, so that it is worth testing in the lab?
setup.hypothesis: I expect the analogue to keep the key hydrogen bonds of celecoxib and to stay in the pocket in a simulation, because only the tolyl methyl is changed. I expect its ADME profile to be similar.
setup.compounds: Celecoxib (reference); Compound B (chloro analogue of celecoxib); Compound C (small fragment). Structures from the teaching data set.
setup.software: AutoDock Vina 1.2.5; SwissADME (web); SwissTargetPrediction, PharmMapper, STRING; GROMACS 2024 (example)

target.notes: Used chain A. Kept the haem. Removed waters except none near the pocket. Protonation at pH 7.4.

funnel.rule: Consensus of shape and docking score

screening.notes: Known COX inhibitors ranked in the top third.

docking.choice: Compound B: its score is as good as celecoxib, it makes the same three key hydrogen bonds, its pose overlays the reference at 1.2 Å and its ligand efficiency is similar.

adme.decision: Continue with Compound B. Its profile is close to celecoxib. I would measure solubility and metabolic stability in liver microsomes, because the chlorine may block methyl oxidation.

network.plan: Test whether Compound B changes PTGS2 and AKT1 pathway activity in cells, with celecoxib as the positive control.

md.water: TIP3P, 0.15 M NaCl, cubic box 1.0 nm
md.notes: Protein RMSD settled at about 1.5 Å after 10 ns. Ligand RMSD stayed near 1.4 Å. The hydrogen bond to HIS90 was present in most frames in all three replicas. RMSF was highest in the loops.

conclude.summary: Compound B behaves like celecoxib in docking, ADME and three 100 ns simulations, and its target network overlaps with inflammation pathways. It is a candidate worth testing.
conclude.limits: 1. The structure is a crystal structure of celecoxib, so the pocket may be biased towards it. 2. Docking scores are approximate and MM-GBSA is a rough ranking. 3. Three 100 ns runs cannot show slow events. 4. The target network comes from predictions.
conclude.reflection: The redocking test and the equilibration steps taught me the most. Next time I would run a longer simulation and add a second docking program to check the scores.
